Aaj ka shaq, kal ki rukawat.
Sky target karo, par step-by-step chalo.
Jo ek ghanta waste karta hai, usne life ki value nahi samjhi.
"Tum kya karte ho itna loud bolta—kehna sunai nahi deta."
"Goals tumhe better banate."
Yesterday se seekho, aaj jiyo, kal hope rakho.
Safalta aakhri manzil nahi, asafalta jaanleva nahi: aage badhne ki himmat hi maayne rakhti hai.
Prepared mind ko fortune milta hai.
"Energy aur persistence sab conquer karegi."
Jo measure hota hai, manage hota hai.
